segments.source: Good morning. You’re speaking with a small-business adviser. I’m calling about a new sole-trader registration. Please confirm your full name and reference number before we continue.
segments.model: 早晨。呢度係小型企業顧問。我聯絡你係關於新成立嘅獨資經營登記。繼續之前，請確認你嘅全名同參考編號。

segments.source: 我最擔心可能要延遲開業或者營運。我想喺下星期五之前處理好。
segments.model: My concern is that I may have to delay starting or running the business. I’d like this resolved before next Friday.

segments.source: The key term is Australian Business Number, or ABN. Generally, official business details must match the entity actually trading. We must check your exact facts.
segments.model: 關鍵用語係澳洲商業號碼，即係 ABN。一般嚟講，正式商業資料要同實際經營嘅實體一致。我哋要核實你嘅實際資料。

segments.source: 我份文件寫住計劃九月一日開始營業。呢個資料我之前記低咗，但唔肯定而家仲係咪最新。你可唔可以幫我核實？
segments.model: My paperwork says trading is planned to start on 1 September. I wrote that down earlier, but I’m not sure it is still current. Could you check it?

segments.source: The record matches that detail. Next, submit the correct application or update and keep the confirmation. Check every date and number before submitting.
segments.model: 紀錄同呢個細節一致。下一步係提交正確申請或者更新資料，並保留確認紀錄。提交之前要核對清楚每個日期同數字。

segments.source: 我已經準備咗有相身份證明同稅務資料。其中一份係電子版本。你哋要正本，定係清晰上載副本都可以？
segments.model: I have photo ID and tax details. One item is electronic. Do you need originals, or are clear uploaded copies acceptable?

segments.source: Unless your notice says otherwise, use the business online portal. Upload photo ID and tax details, then save the receipt or reference.
segments.model: 除非通知另有指示，否則用商業網上平台。上載有相身份證明同稅務資料，之後保存收據或者參考編號。

segments.source: 通常要等幾耐？我擔心可能要延遲開業或者營運。如果聽日都冇消息，我係咪應該再打電話？
segments.model: How long should I wait? I’m worried that I may have to delay starting or running the business. Should I call again if I hear nothing tomorrow?

segments.source: Allow about five business days. Meanwhile, keep using only verified business details until any change is confirmed. Don’t submit the same request twice unless asked.
segments.model: 預大約五個工作日。期間，任何更改確認之前只使用已核實嘅商業資料。除非有人要求，否則唔好重複提交同一要求。

segments.source: 如果我唔同意結果，可唔可以要求覆核或者投訴？我係咪應該先要求書面理由？
segments.model: If I disagree with the outcome, can I request a review or complain? Should I ask for written reasons first?

segments.source: Ask for written reasons and keep a dated record. After that, ask the agency to check or correct the record in writing.
segments.model: 要求書面理由，並保留有日期嘅紀錄。之後，要求相關部門以書面核對或者更正紀錄。

segments.source: 明白。我會照做並保存確認紀錄。我亦會記低澳洲商業號碼，即係 ABN，等下次用返正確講法。
segments.model: Understood. I’ll follow that step and save the confirmation. I’ll note Australian Business Number, or ABN so I use the right wording next time.

segments.source: 多謝你打嚟小型企業顧問。我見到有一個關於擬登記嘅商業名稱嘅查詢。首先請確認姓名同紀錄上嘅參考編號。
segments.model: Thanks for calling a small-business adviser. I can see an enquiry about a proposed business name. First, please confirm your name and the reference on the record.

segments.source: I received an update today. It mentions registered business name, and I’m not sure what that means for my situation.
segments.model: 我今日收到更新，入面提到註冊商業名稱。我唔肯定呢個詞對我嘅情況有咩意思。

segments.source: 呢個詞重要，因為正式商業資料要同實際經營嘅實體一致。你目前紀錄亦顯示擬用名稱係 Harbour Home Repairs。
segments.model: That term matters because official business details must match the entity actually trading. Your current record also says the proposed name is Harbour Home Repairs.

segments.source: So that detail still applies? I need to know before the end of this month, because I may have to delay starting or running the business.
segments.model: 即係呢個細節仍然適用？我需要喺今個月底之前知道，因為可能要延遲開業或者營運。

segments.source: 係，現有紀錄係咁顯示。如果資料錯誤或者唔完整，就要提交正確申請或者更新資料，並保留確認紀錄。
segments.model: Yes, that is what the current record shows. If it is wrong or incomplete, submit the correct application or update and keep the confirmation.

segments.source: I’ve gathered ABN details and contact information. Which parts should I send, and can I submit them online rather than bring paper copies?
segments.model: 我已經準備咗ABN 資料同聯絡資料。我要交邊部分？可唔可以網上提交，而唔使帶紙本？

segments.source: 除非通知列明另一種方法，否則用商業網上平台。上載清晰副本，並保留提交參考編號。
segments.model: Use the business online portal unless your notice gives another method. Upload readable copies and keep the submission reference.

segments.source: If I submit everything today, what should I do while the matter is being assessed? I don’t want to accidentally make it worse.
segments.model: 如果我今日交齊資料，評估期間應該做啲咩？我唔想無意中令情況變差。

segments.source: 一般參考時間係大約七至十個工作日。等候期間，任何更改確認之前只使用已核實嘅商業資料，並留意任何正式訊息。
segments.model: The usual guide is about seven to ten business days. While you wait, keep using only verified business details until any change is confirmed, and monitor any official messages.

segments.source: If the final outcome is negative, can I ask the service to explain exactly why before I decide whether to challenge it?
segments.model: 如果最後結果對我不利，我可唔可以先要求機構清楚解釋原因，再決定係咪提出覆核？

segments.source: 可以。要求以書面提供決定同理由。如果問題仍然未解決，要求相關部門以書面核對或者更正紀錄。
segments.model: Yes. Ask for the decision and reasons in writing. If the issue remains unresolved, ask the agency to check or correct the record in writing.

segments.source: All right. I’ll keep the documents together and use registered business name when I contact the service again.
segments.model: 好。我會將文件整理好，下次再聯絡服務機構時會用返註冊商業名稱呢個詞。
